rust_summary: a cancellable first-person hand render hook (`native_render_hand`).
doc_summary: `native_render_hand(hand, stack, partial, swing, equip, canceled)` runs before each visible first-person hand: `Hand::Main` or `Hand::Off`, the displayed stack (None for an empty arm), partial tick, swing progress and inverse equip height including swap animation scale. Set `canceled` to skip the default geometry for that hand (arms and maps included). It runs after the existing spectator, hidden-HUD, sleep and camera gates. It only hides: the hook has no way to draw a replacement. Bundles need "hooks": @API:render_hand@.
